zh: 他告诉我会议改到下午三点了。
old_en: He told me the meeting was moved to three o'clock.
new_en: He told me the meeting is now at three in the afternoon.

zh: 老板让我明天早点到。
old_en: The boss said I should get to work early tomorrow.
new_en: The boss said to get to work early tomorrow.

zh: 老板叫我明天早上八点前到。
old_en: The boss told me to be at the office before eight tomorrow morning.
new_en: The boss told me to be there before eight tomorrow morning.

zh: 妈妈提醒我带伞。
old_en: Mom said to bring an umbrella.
new_en: Mom reminded me to bring an umbrella.

zh: 同事说他下周要请假。
old_en: A colleague said he will take leave next week.
new_en: A colleague said he will take time off next week.

zh: 客服说会帮我查一下。
old_en: The customer service said they would check it for me.
new_en: Customer service said they would look into it for me.

zh: 客服说会帮我查一下订单，让我等一会儿。
old_en: The customer service said they would check my order and asked me to wait a moment.
new_en: The customer service said they would check my order and asked me to wait a moment.

zh: 老师告诉我们考试很简单。
old_en: The teacher told us the exam was very easy.
new_en: The teacher told us the exam was very easy.

zh: 老师告诉我们这次考试不会太难。
old_en: The teacher told us this exam wouldn't be too difficult.
new_en: The teacher told us this exam wouldn't be too difficult.

zh: 邻居问我能不能帮忙收个快递。
old_en: The neighbor asked me if I could help him receive a package.
new_en: The neighbor asked me if I could help him get a package.

zh: 邻居问我下午能不能帮他收快递。
old_en: The neighbor asked me if I could help him receive a package in the afternoon.
new_en: The neighbor asked me if I could pick up a package for him this afternoon.

zh: 他问我喜不喜欢这个城市。
old_en: He asked me if I liked this city.
new_en: He asked me if I liked this city.

zh: 他昨天告诉我，会议改到三点了。
old_en: He told me yesterday that the meeting was rescheduled for three o'clock.
new_en: He told me yesterday that the meeting is now at three.

zh: 医生说我应该多喝水。
old_en: The doctor told me I should drink more water.
new_en: The doctor said I should drink more water.

zh: 医生告诉我要多喝水，少喝咖啡。
old_en: The doctor told me to drink more water and less coffee.
new_en: The doctor said I should drink more water and less coffee.

zh: 朋友问我周末有没有空。
old_en: He said/told/me he wondered if I was free this weekend.
new_en: A friend asked if I was free this weekend.

zh: 朋友打电话问我周末有没有时间。
old_en: She said she had plans for the weekend.
new_en: A friend called to ask if I had time this weekend.

zh: 出门前妈妈提醒我带一把伞。
old_en: Before leaving, my mom told me to bring an umbrella.
new_en: Mom reminded me to take an umbrella before leaving.

zh: 同事告诉我他下周请假三天。
old_en: My colleague told me he's taking three days off next week.
new_en: My colleague told me he's taking three days off next week.

zh: 他问我住在这里习不习惯。
old_en: He asked me if I was used to living here.
new_en: He asked me if I'm used to living here.
